note: magic taken apart, long games on medium land maps, 24 per config: the seven-switch test found M = magicFocus + skillChoice clearly harmful (-0.180 +- 0.105 score; with M the army falls behind from day 57 on) without telling which half. G = magicFocus alone (mage guilds of all levels, valued by what the main hero can learn); K = skillChoice alone (secondary skills by the hero's role and army); Z = fights against map guards judged by simulation with the hero's damage spells played and its spell points priced (fightForecast + spellForecast - the forecast with spells was checked against the game: 372 guard fights of heroes with bolts, forecast from the armies alone 0.463 mean loss against 0.274 real, with the spells 0.306 against 0.272); J = attacks on enemy heroes judged by simulation (heroForecast; with Z our hero's spells and the enemy's seen damage spells are played). Design 2^(4-1), I = G*K*Z*J, resolution IV: every main effect rests on 96 against 96 games. Evaluate: arena/effects.py <out>/m-land-2p --factors '{"G":{"magicFocus":1},"K":{"skillChoice":1},"Z":{"spellForecast":1},"J":{"heroForecast":1}}'
